defect.detail: The issued T14 TaskSpec inherits forbidden_files entries research_state/control_plane/policies/ and research_state/control_plane/inventories/ from T13 while allowed_files includes the same roots. build_task_report_v2 therefore rejects any changed_file under those roots (UNEXPECTED_CHANGE), and a failed/in_doubt ticket would permanently block PhaseGateCloser PASS closure. The Authority store has no post-issuance spec amendment or ticket voiding API.

freeze_capture_worktree_handling.detail: daily_run.py and daily_select.py carry user worktree modifications that the Git source-identity capture treats as active dirty paths (only CHANGELOG.md and docs/b1_v3_results.md are nonblocking). For freeze/inventory capture only, those two files were temporarily stashed (git stash push), the freeze/inventory/policy artifacts were captured against the clean HEAD identity, and the stash was popped immediately with byte-exact restoration verified. The user files remain modified in the worktree and are not committed by this gate.

disposition.rationale: The final inventory and policy remain fully hash-bound in the validation receipt, completion receipt, publication/activation receipts, and the official Gate artifact sections; the single P6R2 gate is closed exactly once as approved by the user.
